mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate combined with a stable federal funds rate signals labor market deterioration that triggers recessionary expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising UNRATE and stable FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During strong GDP growth periods (quarterly GDP above 2.5% annualized), corporate earnings acceleration drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when GDPC1 > 2.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past month indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1.4 million units annually, it signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 1.4 million units, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE above 5.0%), economic weakness dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
